title: Alphonso Mango Shrikhand Froyo
subtitle: Aamrakhand, frozen and protein-packed
intro: Every Maharashtrian and Gujarati summer has a bowl of aamrakhand: thick yogurt, Alphonso pulp, saffron and elaichi. This pint keeps the flavour and adds a scoop of whey, so dessert out-proteins most shakes.

ingredients.note: or Amul Greek yogurt, or hung curd
Swad or Ratna's tin; Kesar pulp works

ingredients.item: saffron, soaked in warm milk, cooled

steps.text: Soak the saffron in 1 tbsp warm milk for 10 min until deep orange; cool to room temperature.
Blend yogurt, mango pulp, milk, saffron milk, sugar, cardamom, whey and xanthan in the Ninja Blast: two 45 s cycles, until silky.
Rest 2–3 min for the foam to settle, then pour into the pint; it sits just under MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Flatten any hump with a spoon, then run LITE ICE CREAM. If crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN once.
Finish with saffron strands and slivered pistachios, like shrikhand at a wedding thali.

tips: Tinned pulp is sweeter than fresh. With fresh Alphonso, add 1 tbsp more sugar or the pint tastes flat frozen.
Hung curd is tangier and denser; thin it with 1 extra tbsp milk so the Blast can turn it over.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and re-spin on LITE ICE CREAM before serving.
swaps: Kesar-elaichi shrikhand: skip the mango; use 300 g yogurt, 30 g sugar and double the saffron.
Whey-free: use 250 g Epigamia Turbo Natural instead of the Greek yogurt and whey (still about 33 g protein).
Mango lassi pint: replace the milk and 50 g of the yogurt with 100 ml Amul High Protein Lassi (Plain).
shop_note: Alphonso pulp: Swad or Ratna's on Blinkit, Zepto, Amazon. Kesar: Baby Brand or Lion. Xanthan: Urban Platter, Amazon.

gym.why: Skyr replaces Greek yogurt for more protein and almost no fat; fresh mango and Munkito replace sweetened tinned pulp and sugar. Allulose keeps the scoop soft, xanthan keeps it silky.

replace.item: ripe mango, fresh or frozen, chopped
replace.note: Alphonso or Kesar; tinned pulp is sweetened

replace.text: Blend skyr, mango, milk, saffron milk, Munkito, cardamom, whey and xanthan in the Ninja Blast: two 45 s cycles, until silky.

diabetic.why: Plain skyr, 100 g fresh mango, unflavoured whey and Munkito: no added sugar and half the fat. Skyr gives shrikhand body; allulose stops it freezing rock hard without gum.

replace.item: ripe mango, fresh or frozen, chopped
replace.note: not tinned pulp, which is sweetened

replace.item: Amul Slim n Trim skimmed milk

gum_option.note: smoother, fewer re-spins; skip for additive-free

insert.text: Peel and chop the mango. Frozen mango chunks work too; thaw them 10 min so the Blast can purée them.

Flatten any hump, then run LITE ICE CREAM. Without gum it can spin crumbly: add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN, up to twice.

title: Epigamia Turbo Chocolate Pint
subtitle: One bottle, one tub, done
respin: Almost always 1–2 re-spins with 1 tbsp milk each
intro: Epigamia's Turbo Chocolate shake packs 25 g protein into 250 ml with no added sugar. Add Turbo's thick protein yogurt and cocoa, and it becomes a dense pint with over 40 g protein, for lazy nights.

ingredients.item: Epigamia Turbo Chocolate protein shake (25 g protein)
ingredients.note: or any 250 ml, 20 g+ protein shake

steps.text: Shake the bottle well. Blend the shake, yogurt, cocoa and xanthan in the Ninja Blast for 30 s.
Rest 2–3 min for the foam to settle, then pour into the pint (about 400 ml, under MAX FILL). Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Let the pint sit 5 min on the counter, then run LITE ICE CREAM.
This lean base usually spins powdery. Add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN; repeat once if needed until glossy.
Eat from the pint, or top with dark chocolate shavings.

tips: Almost zero fat means the texture depends on the re-spin. For a creamier pint, blend in 1 tbsp peanut butter (adds about 95 kcal).
No Blast handy? Whisk everything in a bowl for a minute. The cocoa may speckle, but it spins out fine.
Leftovers turn rock hard. Flatten, refreeze and re-spin with a splash of milk.
swaps: Mocha: use Turbo Coffee and keep the cocoa.
Malai kulfi: use the Turbo 30 g Malai Kulfi shake, skip the cocoa and add a pinch of cardamom (about 48 g protein).
Cookies & cream: use Turbo Cookies & Cream, skip the cocoa, and MIX-IN 2 crushed Oreos after spinning.
shop_note: Turbo shakes and the 430 g Turbo yogurt tub (50 g protein): Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart. Xanthan gum: Urban Platter on Amazon.

gym.why: Already lean and high-protein. Milk powder adds body and protein without fat; a little Munkito is mainly for softness, as allulose lowers the freezing point, so fewer re-spins.

replace.text: Shake the bottle well. Blend the shake, yogurt, cocoa, milk powder, Munkito and xanthan in the Ninja Blast for 30–40 s.
Rest 2–3 min for the foam to settle, then pour into the pint (about 425 ml, under MAX FILL). Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Milk powder and allulose make it far less powdery. If needed, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN once until glossy.

diabetic.why: Plain Amul High Protein Milk replaces the flavoured shake (which hides sucralose); extra cocoa and Munkito bring back the chocolate. Allulose keeps this gum-free, lean pint scoopable.

replace.note: plain, 35 g protein; not the flavoured shakes

gum_option.note: smoother, fewer re-spins; skip for additive-free

replace.text: Blend the protein milk, yogurt, cocoa and Munkito in the Ninja Blast for 30–40 s, until no cocoa specks remain.
Rest 2–3 min for the foam to settle, then pour into the pint (about 430 ml, under MAX FILL). Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Eat from the pint, or grate over a little Amul 99% cacao dark chocolate.

title: Mixed Berry Skyr Froyo
subtitle: Frozen berries, skyr and a little honey
respin: Re-spin once with 1–2 tbsp milk if crumbly
intro: Frozen mixed berries from the quick-commerce freezer aisle bring real berry flavour any month of the year. Blended with thick skyr and a little honey, they spin into a tart, magenta froyo.

ingredients.note: or Greek yogurt + ½ scoop more whey

steps.text: Let the berries sit 15 min to soften and release their juice.
Blend the berries and juice, skyr, milk, honey, whey and xanthan in the Ninja Blast for 45–60 s until no chunks remain.
Rest 2–3 min for the foam to settle, then pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run SMOOTHIE BOWL; fruit sugars and skyr give a soft-serve texture. If the edges are crumbly, add 1–2 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Serve as a froyo cup or a breakfast bowl with granola and fresh berries.

tips: Berry mixes vary in tartness. The blended base should taste slightly too sweet, because freezing dulls sweetness.
For a seed-free pint, blend the berries alone first, strain through a tea strainer, then blend in the rest.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, then re-spin on SMOOTHIE BOWL.
swaps: Strawberry: use 160 g frozen or fresh strawberries and 1 tbsp more honey.
Turbo: swap the skyr for a 140 g Epigamia Turbo Mixed Berries cup plus 60 g Turbo Natural.
Sugar-free: replace the honey with 45 g Munkito Monk Sweet + Allulose; run LITE ICE CREAM instead.
shop_note: Frozen berries: Pluckk, Delishh or RealFrost on Blinkit/Zepto. Milky Mist Skyr: Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart. Xanthan: Urban Platter, Amazon.

gym.why: Munkito replaces the honey and a full scoop of whey lifts protein. Allulose keeps the froyo soft and xanthan stops iciness, but it now runs best on LITE ICE CREAM.

replace.text: Blend the berries and juice, skyr, milk, Munkito, whey and xanthan in the Ninja Blast for 45–60 s until no chunks remain.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. If the edges are crumbly, add 1–2 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.

diabetic.why: Fewer berries, more plain skyr, skimmed milk, unflavoured whey and Munkito instead of honey. Skyr carries the body and allulose keeps it soft without gum.

replace.item: Amul Slim n Trim skimmed milk

gum_option.note: smoother, fewer re-spins; skip for additive-free

replace.text: Blend the berries and juice, skyr, skimmed milk, Munkito and whey in the Ninja Blast for 45–60 s until no chunks remain.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. Gum-free, the edges may be crumbly: add 1–2 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN, up to twice.
Serve as a froyo cup or a breakfast bowl with fresh berries and a few toasted almonds.

title: Rasmalai Paneer Protein Ice Cream
subtitle: Kesar-elaichi malai, over 60 g protein
intro: Rasmalai is paneer soaking in saffron milk, so blending high-protein paneer into kesar milk is a short step. Blitzed smooth with condensed milk and cardamom, it tastes like the last bowl at a Bengali wedding.

ingredients.item: Amul High Protein Paneer, room temperature
ingredients.note: regular paneer: about 50 g protein total

ingredients.item: saffron, soaked in warm milk, cooled

steps.text: Soak the saffron in 1 tbsp warm milk for 10 min; cool. Crumble the paneer finely.
Blend the paneer with the 180 ml milk in the Ninja Blast, two or three 60 s cycles, until completely smooth.
Add condensed milk, saffron milk, cardamom, kewra and xanthan; blend 20 s more.
Pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. If chalky, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add the pistachios and run MIX-IN.
Scatter a few saffron strands on top and serve at once.

tips: Graininess means under-blended paneer. Use it at room temperature and blend it with the milk alone first.
Rasmalai should taste clearly sweet. If your paneer is sour, add 1 more tbsp condensed milk.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and re-spin before serving again.
swaps: Lower sugar: replace the condensed milk with 25 g milk powder and 45 g Munkito Monk Sweet + Allulose.
Angoori: MIX-IN 2 chopped Haldiram's rasgullas, squeezed dry, with the pistachios.
Regular paneer: use 200 g fresh malai paneer plus 15 g unflavoured whey; rest the base 2–3 min for the foam to settle.
shop_note: Amul High Protein Paneer: Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart, BigBasket. Kewra water: kirana or Amazon. Xanthan: Urban Platter, Amazon.

gym.why: Milk powder and Munkito replace condensed milk; skimmed milk cuts fat. Paneer still gives the rasmalai body and allulose keeps it soft. Fat (16 g) is mostly paneer and pistachio.

replace.item: Amul Slim n Trim skimmed milk

replace.text: Add milk powder, Munkito, saffron milk, cardamom, kewra and xanthan; blend 30 s more.

diabetic.why: Less paneer, skimmed milk and milk powder halve the fat; Munkito replaces condensed milk. Fully blended paneer plus milk powder keeps it creamy, and allulose softens it without gum.

replace.item: Amul High Protein Paneer, room temperature
Amul Slim n Trim skimmed milk

gum_option.note: smoother, fewer re-spins; skip for additive-free

replace.text: Blend the paneer with the 200 ml milk in the Ninja Blast, two or three 60 s cycles, until completely smooth.
Add milk powder, Munkito, saffron milk, cardamom and kewra; blend 30 s more.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. Gum-free, it may spin chalky: add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN, up to twice.

title: Amul Protein Shake Pint Hack
subtitle: Two cartons in, one pint out
intro: Amul's High Protein Blueberry Shake packs 20 g protein into a 200 ml carton with no added sugar. Two cartons fill a pint to just under the line: snip, pour, freeze, spin.

ingredients.item: Amul High Protein Blueberry Shake (20 g protein each)

steps.text: Shake the cartons and blend both with the xanthan and cream in the Ninja Blast for 20 s. No Blast? Whisk hard in the pint.
Rest 2–3 min for the foam to settle; pour into the pint, just under MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Let it stand 5 min, then run LITE ICE CREAM.
Lean shakes need this: add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN; repeat once if still powdery.
Serve plain or with fresh blueberries.

tips: Without xanthan the pint is icier but still good; the pinch roughly halves the re-spins.
Freeze the shake in the CREAMi pint, never the carton. Only the pint locks into the machine.
Leftovers: flatten, refreeze and re-spin with a splash of milk.
swaps: Blueberry cheesecake: replace 60 ml of shake with 60 g Greek yogurt; MIX-IN 2 crushed digestives after spinning.
Kool Protein: use two 180 ml Amul Kool Protein bottles (10 g protein each) plus 15 g whey, for about 31 g.
Epigamia route: one 250 ml Turbo shake plus 150 g Turbo Natural yogurt (see Epigamia Turbo Chocolate Pint).
shop_note: Amul High Protein Blueberry Shake: Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart, BigBasket or shop.amul.com. Xanthan gum: Urban Platter on Amazon.

gym.why: Already lean and sugar-free. Milk powder replaces the optional cream, adding protein and body without fat, so the pint spins creamier with fewer re-spins.

replace.text: Shake the cartons and blend both with the milk powder and xanthan in the Ninja Blast for 30 s, until no powder lumps remain.
Milk powder cuts the powderiness. If needed, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN once.

diabetic.why: Flavoured shakes hide sucralose, so use plain Amul High Protein Milk with real blueberries, unsweetened Turbo yogurt and Munkito. Yogurt adds body and allulose keeps it soft without gum.

replace.note: plain, 35 g protein; not the flavoured shakes

gum_option.note: smoother, fewer re-spins; skip for additive-free

replace.text: Blend the protein milk, blueberries, yogurt and Munkito in the Ninja Blast for 45 s, until smooth and purple.
Lean, gum-free bases need this: add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN; repeat once if still powdery.
Serve plain or with a few fresh blueberries.

title: Honey Anjeer Greek Froyo
subtitle: Soaked figs, honey and Turbo yogurt
intro: Anjeer ice cream is a dry-fruit-shop favourite, all jammy sweetness and crunchy seeds. Figs soaked overnight in milk blend with Turbo yogurt, honey and a spoon of cream, with chewy fig and walnut folded through.

steps.text: Soak the chopped figs in the milk, covered, in the fridge for at least 4 h or overnight.
Blend the figs and their milk in the Ninja Blast for 40 s. Add yogurt, honey, cream and xanthan; blend 20 s more.
Pour into the pint below MAX FILL and tap out air bubbles. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. If crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add the chopped figs and walnuts, and run MIX-IN.
Serve with a thin drizzle of honey.

tips: Soak the figs cold, not in hot milk, so the base goes straight into the Blast with no cooling wait.
Turbo yogurt is almost fat-free; the 2 tbsp cream is what stops this pint going icy. Don't skip it.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and re-spin before serving again.
swaps: Anjeer-akhrot kulfi: add ¼ tsp cardamom and 1 tbsp milk powder to the base.
Dates: use 50 g soft seedless dates (e.g. Lion) instead of figs, and cut the honey to 1 tbsp.
Skyr: use 230 g Milky Mist Skyr instead of Turbo; protein stays about the same.
shop_note: Dried figs: Happilo or Nutraj on Blinkit or Amazon. Epigamia Turbo yogurt: Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart. Xanthan: Urban Platter, Amazon.

gym.why: Munkito replaces honey; milk powder replaces cream, adding protein without fat. The figs still bring jammy sweetness, and allulose plus xanthan stop the lean base going icy.

replace.text: Blend the figs and their milk in the Ninja Blast for 40 s. Add yogurt, Munkito, milk powder and xanthan; blend 20 s more.
Serve with a few walnut halves or a slice of fresh fig.

diabetic.why: Dried figs concentrate sugar, so use half as many and skip the fig mix-in; Munkito replaces honey, milk powder replaces cream. Milk powder and allulose keep it smooth without gum.

replace.item: Amul Slim n Trim skimmed milk

gum_option.note: smoother, fewer re-spins; skip for additive-free

replace.text: Blend the figs and their milk in the Ninja Blast for 40 s. Add yogurt, Munkito and milk powder; blend 20 s more.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. Gum-free, it may be crumbly: add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN, up to twice.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add the walnuts, and run MIX-IN.
Serve with a couple of walnut halves on top.

title: Piña Colada Protein Froyo
subtitle: Pineapple, coconut milk, zero rum
intro: Goa shack flavours in a pint: sweet pineapple, rich coconut milk and Greek yogurt tang, with vanilla whey for protein. Entirely non-alcoholic, sunny yellow and finished with toasted coconut.

ingredients.note: fresh, or canned in juice, drained

steps.text: Blend pineapple, yogurt, coconut milk, sugar and salt in the Ninja Blast for 30 s. Add whey and xanthan; blend 20 s more.
Rest 2–3 min for the foam to settle, then pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. If powdery, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add the toasted coconut and run MIX-IN.
Serve in a hollowed pineapple half or a chilled glass with a pineapple wedge.

tips: Fresh pineapple's bromelain can thin dairy and turn it slightly bitter if the base sits. Freeze straight away, or use canned.
Shake the coconut milk hard: the cream separates and you want both parts.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and re-spin before serving again.
swaps: Whey-free: replace the yogurt and whey with 200 g Epigamia Turbo Natural (about 27 g protein).
Vegan-leaning: use plant protein (OZiva, MuscleBlaze) and coconut yogurt; add ½ scoop more protein to compensate.
Tropical: swap half the pineapple for ripe mango pulp.
shop_note: Coconut milk: Dabur Hommade or Real Thai on Blinkit, Zepto, BigBasket. Xanthan gum: Urban Platter on Amazon.

gym.why: Half the coconut milk (topped up with skimmed milk), fat-free Turbo yogurt and Munkito instead of sugar. Coconut flavour stays; whey, xanthan and allulose keep the scoop smooth.

diabetic.why: Less pineapple, half the coconut milk, unsweetened Turbo yogurt, unflavoured whey and Munkito: no added sugar, under half the fat. Yogurt body and allulose keep it creamy without gum.

replace.note: fresh; tinned is usually in syrup

add.item: Amul Slim n Trim skimmed milk

gum_option.note: smoother, fewer re-spins; skip for additive-free

replace.text: Blend pineapple, yogurt, coconut milk, skimmed milk, Munkito and salt in the Ninja Blast for 30 s. Add whey; blend 20 s more.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. Gum-free, it may be powdery: add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN, up to twice.

title: Chikoo Malai Protein
subtitle: A Juhu-style chikoo scoop, with paneer
intro: Mumbai's Natural Ice Cream made chikoo famous: malty, brown-sugar sweet and a little grainy. Ripe chikoos blended with high-protein paneer and a splash of cream scoop like the real thing, with over 30 g protein.

ingredients.item: Amul High Protein Paneer, room temperature

steps.text: Peel the chikoos, remove the black seeds and white core strip, and chop roughly.
Blend the paneer and milk in the Ninja Blast, two 60 s cycles, until completely smooth.
Add chikoo, cream, condensed milk and xanthan; blend 30 s.
Pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. If crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN once.
Top with small cubes of fresh chikoo.

tips: Use chikoos that give when pressed. Underripe fruit has latex that tastes chalky, and freezing makes it worse.
The fine grain is part of chikoo's charm, so don't chase a perfectly smooth base.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and re-spin before serving again.
swaps: Chikoo-coffee: add 1 tsp instant coffee dissolved in 1 tbsp milk.
Yogurt route: replace the paneer and milk with 200 g Epigamia Turbo Natural (about 27 g protein).
Sitaphal: use 180 g deseeded custard-apple pulp; frozen pulp works off-season.
shop_note: Chikoo: Blinkit or Zepto fruit aisle, best Oct–Mar. Amul High Protein Paneer: Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart, BigBasket.

gym.why: Milk powder replaces the cream and Munkito replaces condensed milk, lifting protein and cutting fat. Ripe chikoo and paneer give the body; allulose keeps it soft.

replace.text: Add chikoo, milk powder, Munkito and xanthan; blend 30 s.

diabetic.why: Chikoo is sugary, so 100 g of it, more paneer, skimmed milk and milk powder instead of cream, Munkito instead of condensed milk. Paneer and milk powder give body; allulose softens it without gum.

Run LITE ICE CREAM. Gum-free, it may be crumbly: add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN, up to twice.
Dust with a pinch of cinnamon and serve.

title: Gulkand Rose Protein Pint
subtitle: Rose lassi and gulkand, paan-shop style
intro: Gulkand, the sticky rose-petal preserve tucked into every meetha paan, makes a floral, jammy base. Amul High Protein Rose Lassi and high-protein paneer bring the protein; pistachio and rose petals bring crunch.

ingredients.item: Amul High Protein Lassi, Rose (15 g protein)
ingredients.note: or 150 g Greek yogurt, 50 ml milk

ingredients.item: Amul High Protein Paneer, room temperature

steps.text: Blend the paneer and milk in the Ninja Blast for 60 s until completely smooth.
Add the rose lassi, gulkand and xanthan; blend 30 s.
Rest 2–3 min for any foam to settle, then pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. If powdery, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add the pistachios and rose petals, and run MIX-IN.
Serve with a small spoon of gulkand on each scoop.

tips: Gulkand brands vary in sweetness. If the blended base tastes mild, add 1 more tbsp gulkand before freezing.
Blending the paneer with only the milk first is the trick to a smooth, not grainy, pint.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and re-spin before serving again.
swaps: Meetha paan: blend 2 Calcutta paan leaves (stems removed) into the base; MIX-IN 1 tbsp tutti-frutti and 1 tsp sweet saunf.
Rose falooda: MIX-IN 1 tbsp soaked, drained sabja seeds and drizzle Rooh Afza on top.
Lighter, tangier: replace the paneer with 120 g Epigamia Turbo Natural.
shop_note: Amul High Protein Rose Lassi: Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart. Gulkand: Dabur or Patanjali. Rose petals: Urban Platter on Amazon.

gym.why: Gulkand is about 75% sugar, so use 2 tsp for flavour and Munkito for sweetness; the rose lassi and petals carry the rose. Allulose keeps it soft. About 9 g added sugar remains.

replace.text: Add the rose lassi, gulkand, Munkito and xanthan; blend 30 s.
Serve with a few crumbled rose petals instead of extra gulkand.

diabetic.why: Gulkand is rose petals preserved in sugar, about 75% sugar, and it is the flavour. Try the Rasmalai Paneer pint's Diabetic version: saffron, kewra and pistachio, no added sugar.

title: Guava Chilli Froyo
subtitle: Pink amrood with a chilli-salt finish
intro: Winter in India means the thela-wala rubbing halved pink guavas with chilli and kala namak. This froyo blends sieved guava with protein yogurt and a pinch of black salt; the chilli dust goes on at the table.

ingredients.item: to finish: Kashmiri chilli powder, kala namak, chaat masala

steps.text: Quarter the guavas, blend with the milk in the Ninja Blast for 20 s, then press through a sieve to remove the seeds.
Rinse the Blast. Blend the sieved pulp, yogurt, sugar, cream, kala namak and xanthan for 30 s until smooth and pink.
Pour into the pint below MAX FILL and tap out air bubbles. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run LITE ICE CREAM.
Add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN; repeat once if still crumbly.
Dust each scoop with a pinch of the chilli-salt mix and a squeeze of lime.

tips: Choose fragrant, slightly soft pink guavas such as Allahabad Surkha. White guavas work, but the pint turns beige.
Don't skip sieving: guava seeds feel like grit in a frozen pint.
Leftovers: flatten, refreeze and re-spin; add the masala only after scooping.
swaps: Kairi twist: use 150 g ripe mango pulp plus 2 tbsp raw-mango pulp instead of guava, with the same masala.
Sweet only: skip the kala namak and chilli masala, and finish with a drizzle of honey.
Greek route: use 250 g Epigamia Greek Natural plus 15 g whey and drop the milk; rest the base 2–3 min for foam.
shop_note: Pink guava: Blinkit or Zepto fruit aisle, best Nov–Feb. Epigamia Turbo yogurt: Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart. Xanthan: Urban Platter, Amazon.

gym.why: Munkito replaces sugar and milk powder replaces cream, adding protein without fat. Allulose keeps the lean Turbo base scoopable, so one re-spin usually does it.

diabetic.why: Less guava, more unsweetened Turbo yogurt, milk powder instead of cream and Munkito instead of sugar. Guava's fibre and the milk powder give body; allulose softens it without gum.

title: Mishti Doi Froyo
subtitle: Kolkata's caramel curd, in a pint
intro: In Kolkata, mishti doi is set in clay pots from milk cooked down with caramelised sugar, so it tastes faintly of toffee and tang. This pint folds that caramel milk into thick hung dahi.

ingredients.note: or 250 g Epigamia Greek yogurt, Natural
optional; many Kolkata shops skip it

steps.text: Hang the dahi in a muslin-lined sieve in the fridge for 2 hours, until thick and about 250 g.
In a heavy pan on medium heat, melt 30 g of the sugar without stirring, swirling the pan, until deep amber, 3–4 min.
Off the heat, carefully pour in the milk; it will spit. Add the rest of the sugar and simmer on medium-low 15 min, stirring, to 180 ml.
Cool the caramel milk fully, about 40 min, or 15 min over ice water. Never put a warm base in the Blast.
Blend the hung dahi, caramel milk, milk powder, salt, cardamom and xanthan in the Ninja Blast 30–45 s, until glossy.
Pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Flatten any hump and run LITE ICE CREAM. If crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN once.
Spoon into small clay kulhads, the way Kolkata sweet shops sell it, with a few pistachio slivers.

tips: Take the caramel to deep amber; a pale caramel vanishes once frozen. If it smells acrid or looks black, start again.
Hung dahi should be thick but spoonable. If it's as firm as paneer, loosen it with 1–2 tbsp of the drained whey.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and re-spin on LITE ICE CREAM before serving.
swaps: Nolen gur doi: in winter, skip caramelising and stir 70 g nolen gur into the reduced milk once it's below 60 °C.
Bhapa doi style: add 2 tbsp Milkmaid to the Blast and cut the sugar to 45 g for a denser, fudgier scoop.
Shortcut: skip hanging and use 250 g Epigamia Greek yogurt, Natural, for about 10 g more protein.
shop_note: Amul Masti dahi and Amul Sagar: any kirana, Blinkit or Zepto. Muslin: any kitchen shop. Xanthan: Urban Platter on Amazon.

gym.why: Skimmed milk and skyr cut the fat; whey lifts protein near 60 g. Munkito browns gently for the caramel note, and allulose keeps the low-fat pint soft and scoopable.

replace.item: Amul Slim n Trim skimmed milk

replace.text: In a heavy pan on low heat, stir 20 g Munkito with 1 tbsp water until light golden, 2–3 min. Allulose browns fast; don't walk away.
Off the heat, pour in the skimmed milk. Simmer on medium-low 15 min, stirring, to 180 ml. Cool 5 min, then stir in the remaining Munkito.
Blend skyr, caramel milk, whey, milk powder, salt, cardamom and xanthan in the Ninja Blast 30–45 s. Rest 2–3 min so the foam settles.

diabetic.why: Munkito, gently caramelised, gives a lighter toffee note with zero added sugar; skimmed milk for the reduction halves the fat. Hung dahi and milk powder hold the body without gum.

replace.item: homemade dahi from Amul Taaza toned milk
Amul Slim n Trim skimmed milk

replace.text: Set dahi overnight from boiled, cooled toned milk, then hang it in muslin in the fridge 2–3 hours, to about 250 g.
On the lowest heat, stir 20 g Munkito with 1 tbsp water until pale gold, 2–3 min. Allulose scorches quickly; pull it early.
Off the heat, pour in the skimmed milk. Simmer on medium-low 15 min, stirring, to 180 ml. Cool 5 min, then stir in the remaining Munkito.
Blend the hung dahi, caramel milk, milk powder, salt and cardamom in the Ninja Blast 30–45 s, until glossy and smooth.

gum_option.note: smoother, fewer re-spins; skip for additive-free
